children: Overview
Canada real estate developer's Q3 revenue declined slightly year-over-year
Q3 earnings before income taxes improved due to higher segment contributions and fair value adjustments
Company completed Chancerygate acquisition in Q3, expanding European platform and assets under management
Outlook
Dream Unlimited expects Q4 to be its strongest quarter of 2026
Company has secured C$100.4 mln in lot and acre sales for Q4 2026 revenue recognition
Result Drivers
ASSET MANAGEMENT FEES - Growth in asset management mandates and higher acquisition and performance fees drove increased revenue and net margin in the asset management business
MULTI-FAMILY RENTAL LEASE-UP - Ongoing completion and leasing of multi-family rental units in Western Canada supported higher income property net operating income
PRODUCT MIX IN DEVELOPMENT SALES - Lower net margin from Western Canada development was attributed to the specific product mix and volume sold during the quarter
